name: final-speed-decode

serve.command: exec env -i HOME=/home/spark USER=spark LOGNAME=spark PATH=/usr/local/cuda/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin RUST_BACKTRACE=1 /home/spark/inkling-2-mini-1x-dgx-spark/bin/rexl3-serve --model /home/spark/models/Inkling-2-Mini-SAGE-REXL3-4.23bpw --max-model-len 262144 --slots 4 --kv-tokens 1048576 --prefill-chunk 4096 --kv-dtype int8 --spec dspark --prefix-cache on --allow-unvalidated-pack --served-model-name inkling-2-mini-1x-dgx-spark --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000

tests.filter: decode: four kinds x 5 runs, every reply equal to the pinned reply (PASS pin), concurrent == solo

commands: ./inkling2mini.sh bench all   (decode phase: warm, 1 stream over four kinds, 4 and 8 at once)
notes: Drafter dspark, prefix cache on, vision on (the shipping defaults), boot g (fresh boot after the pin boot), GPU capped at 2,200 MHz. Medians over every run of the phase: `bench all` and the later `bench decode` / `bench rolling` passes (each starts with its own discarded warm-up); decode_mean4_tok_s is the mean over prose, code, structured and json of the median run. decode_c4_aggregate_tok_s is the span number (all tokens over the span to the last reply), decode_c8_aggregate_tok_s is 8 requests on 4 slots. decode_c1_4k_tok_s is c = 1 on a cold 4,096-token prompt (256 tokens), median of 3.
